notablePrerequisites:
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
The Dwarf Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
